coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: UCSF Bayfront Medical Building
record.summary: 520 Illinois Street (per Commercial Property Executive), a five-story clinical building (Stantec design; Clark Construction leading the integrated project delivery team; floor-area figures differ between sources, see open questions) on UCSF's Block 34, at the corner of 3rd and Mariposa Streets -- Pier & Point identifies this as the north portion of what it had tracked as one combined "block 34" area, split 2026-09-22 along a visible roofline seam from the Illinois Street Garage immediately south of it; per SF YIMBY the clinical building and the garage are both part of UCSF's development of Block 34.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL BUILDING, APPROXIMATE BOUNDARY -- a real, standing structure clearly visible in Esri satellite imagery (not open land). Boundary is the traced edge of the leftover open ground between the mapped streets (following the street's curb radius) and neighbouring mapped shapes, with the north edge (and, for the garage, the cut from the building to its north) re-aligned to the real street angle -- not a hand-traced or surveyed building footprint. The split between this building and its neighbor follows a visible satellite roofline seam, not a surveyed or permitted lot line -- treat the exact boundary as indicative, not authoritative. How this shape was traced, including earlier versions, is logged in its data file in the public data repository (https://github.com/pierandpoint/record). DataSF's Assessor layer has one active lot, 8725001 (480 16th St, MB-RA zoning, recorded 1999-09-21, 15,504 m2), under this building and the two other tracked buildings on this strip between Third St and Illinois St (UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision, UCSF Bayfront Medical Building and UCSF Illinois Street Garage). No lot separates them, so this outline is a drawing of the building from imagery, kept because the lot is not this building's own.
notes.digitized_from: Traced as the leftover open ground between 3rd St and Illinois St, south of 16th St, extended down to Mariposa St, after removing the mapped streets (at full street width) and already-tracked neighbouring shapes. Pier & Point identified this area as capturing two separate real buildings, not one, and cut it at the visible gap between the two rooflines in Esri satellite imagery (lat 37.76578) -- the piece north of that cut is the UCSF Valley Center for Vision (west building) record.
notes.why_no_real_parcel: The strip holds one Assessor lot, 8725001, under three separately drawn buildings (see the accuracy note), so no lot of its own exists for this building.

open_questions: 2026-09-22, corroborating data point: DataSF business registrations whose point-location falls inside this record's shape list '520 Illinois St # D2317' and '520 Illinois St # D1200' as their address -- matching the 520 Illinois St address already sourced from UCSF Real Estate's own project page, not contradicting it. That match is by location only and was not individually confirmed, so this is logged as corroboration, not an independent primary source.

SPLIT 2026-09-22: this record was previously a single OCII plan block 34 record (a probable, geographically-inferred identity for the WHOLE of a mapped area that also included the Illinois Street Garage to its south). This was corrected: UCSF built three real structures where the OCII plan showed two, and Bayfront Medical Building is only the north piece of that area (the Illinois Street Garage record covers the south piece). The split follows a visible satellite roofline seam, not a surveyed or permitted lot line, and its exact boundary should be treated as indicative rather than authoritative.

Floor-area figures disagree and none is shown as this building's size. SF YIMBY (October 2, 2021): "The structure will span 182,800 square feet of floor area." Healthcare Facilities Today (August 29, 2024): "The five-story, all-electric, 181,000-square-foot building". Stantec (September 17, 2024): "the clinic's 183,000 square feet". Clark's project page: "The 190,000-square-foot clinical building". Guttmann & Blaevoet: "Clinical Building: 190,000 SF". Some figures are pre-construction plans and some were written after opening, and the sources do not say what each measures. A total project cost of about $335.8 million for the clinical building and garage together was cited in an earlier version of this record with no named source; it could not be traced to one, so it is not shown. Other figures found: Guttmann & Blaevoet gives "a $210M, 190,000sf clinical building" and "a $32M, 500-stall parking garage" ("Cost: $242 million"), and Commercial Property Executive's $228 million (see costs) is attributed to the San Francisco Chronicle; they disagree, and none is a UCSF or Regents document.

As of 2026-10-12, UCSF Real Estate's project page could not be read (HTTP 403). Stantec's news release (September 17, 2024) and Clark's project page and 2021 release are readable and support the story count, the architect and the construction team; the 520 Illinois St address rests on Commercial Property Executive (unreadable on re-read) and on DBI permit M1227947, which lists "520 illinois street and 590 illinois street" for UCSF block 8725, lot 001. The Regents outcome for the May 2020 Block 34 items was not found (only the committee agenda was read). The construction start is Clark's September 2021 groundbreaking announcement; CPE and Clark say the garage began earlier (April 2021). UCSF's Department of Ophthalmology directions page gives "a UCSF parking structure at 590 Illinois Street (same block as our 490 Illinois Street clinic building)", and the DBI permit lists 590 Illinois Street beside 520 without saying which building is which; SF YIMBY puts the garage at 499 Illinois Street. Whether CPE's $228 million includes the garage is not stated.

Update 2026-10-12: the opening is confirmed by sources written after it, but none read names the opening day. Hospital Management (August 26, 2024) says the building was "due to start receiving patients on 27 August" (a scheduled date, published the day before); Healthcare Facilities Today (August 29, 2024) and Stantec (September 17, 2024) report it open without giving the day; Commercial Property Executive's opening coverage (commercialsearch.com), UCSF Real Estate's project page and UCSF's news site returned HTTP 403. The opening is therefore shown at month level. The $228 million figure and the garage "came online in 2023" statement also come from the Commercial Property Executive page, which could not be re-read. SF YIMBY (February 8, 2023) had said the building was "expected to open later this year"; the sources do not say when the opening date moved.

record.notes: OCII plan block 34 (north portion). Between 3rd St and Illinois St, south of block 33 (Valley Center for Vision), north of the Illinois Street Garage. 520 Illinois St (Commercial Property Executive), 5 stories (Clark), ~182,800 sq ft (SF YIMBY), architect Stantec, GC Clark Construction, scheduled to open to patients on Aug 27 2024 (Hospital Management, Aug 26 2024); no source written after the opening could be read, so the day is unconfirmed.
